purpose: Fail-closed contract from requirement/design intent to product characteristics, CAD semantics, drawing projection and inspection. Prevents drawing work from becoming a second engineering authority.
principles: The product is defined before the drawing is authored. The drawing is a projection, not a place where nominal values, tolerances, fits, GD&T, roughness, material or process requirements are invented.
Every manufacturing/inspection characteristic has a stable characteristic ID and explicit source authority.
A nominal CAD value does not imply a released tolerance. OPEN remains OPEN and must not inherit a SOLIDWORKS/general-template default.
Legacy candidate_spec text is never release authority. If it conflicts with current decisions it is reported as STALE_CANDIDATE_SPEC and ignored by downstream release projection.
Native PMI/DimXpert is the preferred semantic carrier for size/fit/GD&T. Other controlled native model annotations are allowed when DimXpert is not the correct carrier.
Drawing automation consumes only the compiled Product Definition contract, never raw legacy candidate strings.
Inspection acceptance consumes the same compiled Product Definition contract; drawing text is not independently parsed into acceptance limits.
Release requires complete functional definition, evidence and inspection method. A design-review/base drawing may show controlled nominals plus explicit OPEN states without inventing release values.

The compiled Product Definition participates in the authoritative engineering DAG. Its semantic fingerprint and its MEDTAS consumed-state fingerprint are distinct: unchanged Cxx values do not make a CAD-binding change fresh.

Any upstream requirement/interface/CAD-binding/Product Definition change invalidates downstream drawing/inspection consumers through graph fingerprints; downstream artifacts are never manually blessed fresh.

requires: all required characteristics exist or are explicitly OPEN
all shown numeric values have an authority source
legacy conflicting numeric candidate specs are excluded from projection
DRAWING_CANDIDATE_READY.allows: Generate/edit a design-review SLDDRW using controlled nominals and explicit OPEN notes.

requires: CAD binding is deterministic for each characteristic to be authored
variation semantics are CONTROLLED for tolerance/fit/GD&T values
PMI_AUTHORING_READY.allows: Author model PMI/annotations on a timestamped candidate and verify save-close-reopen semantics.

requires: functional tolerance analysis complete where applicable
surface texture/process notes closed where required
inspection method and acceptance criterion linked

mutation_rule: Any change of execution method, characteristic semantics or authority precedence must atomically update architecture/decision/next-action control and its acceptance test in the same patch before implementation begins.

attempt_rule.exception_requires: explicit decision-log entry with new evidence and bounded experiment
